span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Advanced mathematical notation must be laid out and held in a mental spatial arrangement, so spatial ability constrains how well the symbols, numerals and letters of a formula can be represented and manipulated
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Learning advanced mathematics requires comprehending unfamiliar technical terminology, the same semantic-comprehension process tapped by the word semantics task, which is why word semantics predicts advanced mathematics
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Basic number sense drops out as a predictor because advanced mathematics operates far away from numerosity and numbers, unlike elementary mathematics which directly involves them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only a narrow slice of advanced mathematical ability was measured, namely acquiring new concepts and solving problems about them.
span.note: what this limits: what 'advanced mathematical ability' means here: A RELATIVELY SMALL RANGE OF HIGH-LEVEL MATHEMATICAL ABILITIES WERE ASSESSED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The cognitive tests themselves are improvable; the numerical-processing tests were not well correlated with each other.
span.note: what this limits: the cognitive measures: THE TESTS INCLUDED FOR EACH TYPE OF COGNITIVE FACTORS CAN BE FURTHER IMPROVED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The participant range was limited to adults who did not major in mathematics or allied disciplines.
span.note: what this limits: the population the result speaks for: THE RANGE OF PARTICIPANTS WAS ALSO LIMITED - adults not majoring in mathematics or allied disciplines
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The tests for one construct do not agree with each other, and the authors state it is unclear whether that means the construct has several types — while the comparison construct behaves as one.
span.note: what this limits: a numerical-processing score in this study as a measure of number sense: the tests were not highly correlated among themselves and the authors state it is unclear whether they reflect different types of number sense
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The headline construct was assessed over a narrow range, which the authors name first among their limitations.
span.note: what this limits: conclusions about advanced mathematics performance in general: only the ability to acquire new advanced concepts and to solve problems was assessed
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The sample excludes both ends of the ability range the conclusions are about.
span.note: what this limits: generalising to mathematicians or to people with mathematical difficulties: the participants were adults who did not major in mathematics, and the authors name both excluded groups as future work
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE NULL WAS PREDICTED, NOT DISCOVERED, and the authors say so before reporting it: 'we EXPECTED TO DISCONFIRM this number sense hypothesis because advanced mathematics is far removed from basic numerical processing', adding that in a college sample the variation in basic number processing should be limited. So the finding is confirmatory of the authors' expectation and partly explained in advance by their sampling, which is a different epistemic object from a surprising null.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: about four hours between the two testing sessions
span.note: eliminates: that second-session performance is depressed by fatigue carried over from the first
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the position of the stimulus on screen was randomly determined within 15 degrees of visual angle
span.note: eliminates: that performance depends on a fixed retinal location rather than on the cognitive demand
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: instructions and practice trials preceded every task
span.note: eliminates: that early performance on each task reflects unfamiliarity rather than ability

span.label: basic numerical processing → advanced mathematics
span.note: A RELATION TESTED AND NOT FOUND: 'basic numerical processing and computation were generally NOT correlated with performance in advanced mathematics'. No edge type can assert an absent relation, and this one is the paper's stated aim - it set out to disconfirm the number-sense hypothesis. Third instance in this session's reading after arthur2022 and pan2023.

span.label: Spatial abilities - mental rotation, spatial working memory and figure analysis - remained significantly correlated with performance in advanced mathematics even after general cognitive, numerical and language processing were partialled out.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: None of the four basic numerical processing (number sense) tasks predicted advanced mathematics once other cognitive factors were controlled, disconfirming the number sense hypothesis for advanced mathematics.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Of the four language tasks, only word semantic processing retained a significant association with advanced mathematics after controls; word rhyming, sentence syntax and paired-associate learning did not.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Complex numerical processing - number series completion and artificial arithmetic learning - stayed significantly correlated with advanced mathematics after all four other cognitive categories were controlled.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: When tasks were combined into summary z-scores, the composite spatial-processing score correlated strongly with advanced mathematics while the composite basic-numerical score showed no correlation at all.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
